visualStudioTranslator.general.translate.title: Translate documentation in tooltips
visualStudioTranslator.general.translate.description: Adds a translation of the documentation below the original when you hover over a symbol.

visualStudioTranslator.general.targetLan.title: Translate into
visualStudioTranslator.general.targetLan.description: The language documentation is translated into. By default, the language Visual Studio is shown in.

visualStudioTranslator.localModel.model.title: Language model
visualStudioTranslator.localModel.model.description: The model that translates on this computer. One that is not downloaded yet is offered for download the next time a translation is needed; a model downloaded before stays, so switching back costs nothing.

visualStudioTranslator.localModel.useGra.title: Use the graphics card
visualStudioTranslator.localModel.useGra.description: Runs the model on the fastest graphics card that works, several times faster than on the processor. Turn off to keep the card free for other work.

visualStudioTranslator.title: Visual Studio Translator
visualStudioTranslator.description: Translation of code documentation into your language.

visualStudioTranslator.localModel.title: Local translation
visualStudioTranslator.localModel.description: The language model that translates on this computer, without sending your code anywhere.
